grades: Entering grade 9 per the Become a Volunteer page. The internship page says entering grades 9-12 or home-school equivalent. Graduating seniors may also apply.
name: WonderCamp High School Summer Intern
org: WonderLab Museum of Science, Health, and Technology
what_you_do: Volunteer your time this summer as a WonderCamp High School Intern. The page lists no specific duties.
who_can_apply: The Become a Volunteer page says WonderCamp applicants must be entering grade 9 in the fall of the next school year. The internships page says entering grades 9-12 or home-school equivalent, and graduating seniors may also apply. Required training is held at University Elementary School.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer internship (the page describes it as volunteering your time)
duration: Summer camp weeks; training also required the Saturday before each camp week
deadline_text: Applications for summer 2027 are open. No closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Here link on WonderLab's internship page. Special training sessions are listed on the application form. Contact: 812-337-1337 ext. 221.
notes: Unpaid. The Become a Volunteer page says WonderCamp interns must be entering grade 9 in the fall of the next school year, while the internship page says entering grades 9 to 12; use the stricter reading (grade 9 or older) unless WonderLab says otherwise.
